data.long_meaning: The name Vipin is recorded with the meaning “Conqueror, Shining One”. Vipin is a Hindu name meaning “Conqueror, Shining One”. in_marathi.name: Vipin
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Conqueror, Shining One
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vipin हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Vipin is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vipin', which means 'conqueror' or 'shining one'. This name is often given to a child who is expected to bring light and victory in their family or community.
